thread.title: Apple announced Apple Watch Series 4 with 40-mm and 44-mm sizes

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple announced Apple Watch Series 4 with 40-mm and 44-mm sizes
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) on Wednesday announced its new Apple Watch Series 4, which will come in 40-millimeter and 44-millimeter sizes. The Series 4 devices have edge-to-edge screens and support more "complications," or small applications, on the watch face. The company also introduced several new watch faces, including ones that will allow users to include photos of their loved ones on their wrist and tap to quickly contact them. The new watches support the ability to take an electrocardiogram from your wrist. Apple Chief Operating Officer Jeff Williams praised new haptic feedback for the watch crown as well as an "absolutely beautiful" watch backing, made of black ceramic and sapphire crystal. That enables better cellular reception, he said. The Apple Watch announcements came at Apple's iPhone launch event (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-event-expected-to-show-off-new-iphones-apple-watch-live-blog-2018-09-12). Apple shares are down 0.3% in Wednesday trading, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 0.3%. Fitbit Inc. (FIT) shares are down 2.4%.
-Emily Bary; 1329ET
